key_items.detail: Microsoft's official zero trust assessment framework now includes dedicated guidance for AI systems, providing structured evaluation criteria for securing AI deployments.

key_items.title: Enterprise Agentic AI Reference Architecture 2026

top_insights: Enterprise AI security is maturing rapidly, with dedicated zero trust frameworks and authentication standards emerging specifically for AI agents and autonomous systems.
The agentic AI paradigm is driving new architectural patterns and security considerations that extend beyond traditional application security models.
Authentication for AI agents represents a critical unsolved challenge, with new protocols like ARD being proposed alongside established OAuth mechanisms.
Microsoft's investment in AI-specific zero trust assessment tools signals mainstream enterprise adoption of AI security governance frameworks.
